root_cause: The focus trap listener (maintainFocus) remains active when restoring focus in hide(), causing it to steal focus back to the dialog after attempting to return focus to the opener.
repair_strategy: Move the removal of the focus and keydown listeners before restoring focus in the hide() method, ensuring the focus trap does not interfere with focus restoration.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus returns to the opener button after the dialog is closed, preserving logical keyboard focus order.
functional_risks: Removing listeners early could theoretically interfere with any pending asynchronous operations that rely on them, but the hide method completes synchronously and no such usage exists.
Ensure that the focus restoration still works for elements that may lose focusability (e.g., SVG) – the existing guard remains unchanged.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape closes the dialog and returns focus to the opener button.
Confirm that the dialog remains hidden (aria-hidden=true) after closing.
Ensure that opening and closing the dialog multiple times continues to work correctly.
Check that focus trapping still functions correctly while the dialog is open (tabbing within dialog does not escape).
